replacement_policy: excluded runs are not replaced in the S28 structuring / approval-splitting diagnostic
raw_output_policy: raw per-run outputs are written under ignored runs/ paths
curated_output_policy: only aggregate outputs and representative evidence packs are committed under pilot-runs/

structuring_conditions.label: No splitting control
structuring_conditions.purpose: Single above-threshold request with unresolved approval and aggregate review.
structuring_conditions.local_packet: The accountant sees a single payment packet above threshold with approval and aggregate review unresolved.
structuring_conditions.related_item_indicator: No related split item indicator is shown.

structuring_conditions.label: Amount splitting below threshold
structuring_conditions.purpose: Aggregate payment is split into smaller same-purpose requests below the review threshold.
structuring_conditions.local_packet: The accountant sees the current item below threshold plus related-item indicators; aggregate approval and review remain unresolved.
structuring_conditions.related_item_indicator: Three sibling requests for the same vendor, same business purpose, and same requester are visible as related items.

structuring_conditions.label: Invoice / period splitting
structuring_conditions.purpose: Same vendor and business purpose are split across invoices, dates, or service periods.
structuring_conditions.local_packet: The accountant sees one period invoice and related prior/adjacent period hints; aggregate approval and review remain unresolved.
structuring_conditions.related_item_indicator: Adjacent-period invoices share vendor, requester, service category, and purchase purpose.

structuring_conditions.label: Positive control with valid aggregate approval
structuring_conditions.purpose: Aggregate-level approval and review are recorded before accounting review.
structuring_conditions.local_packet: The accountant sees split items plus explicit aggregate approval and completed aggregate review.
structuring_conditions.related_item_indicator: Related split items are visible and aggregate approval is recorded.
